resources.string: Detect visits when route recording is off. This optional mode uses balanced-power location and keeps an ongoing notification. It uses battery; detection can be delayed or unavailable when location quality is insufficient.
During route recording, visits use its location updates. When the route stops, Visits only resumes balanced-power updates. Each mode has its own Stop action.
After a phone restart, force-stop or service interruption, open Whereday and start again. Visits only does not restart automatically.
Visit detection stopped. Review location access and start again when ready.
Notifications are disabled. Android may hide the notification from the shade; the foreground service remains visible in the system active-apps controls.
Approximate location may be too imprecise to detect visits. You can review precise access in system settings.
The change could not be completed. Check location access and the current status, then try again.
Notifications are disabled. You may not see the ongoing notification. You can stop Visits only here in Whereday.
